fact: Burkina24 reported on 17 September 2021 that the SDAN broadband master plan was drawn up under the 2017-2020 action plan of the national digital economy development strategy (SN@DEN) and adopted by decree in the Council of Ministers; the article gives no costing.
title: Internet au Burkina Faso : Bientôt du très haut débit à Ouaga, Bobo et Koudougou
